## Summary

**Current Status:**
- Budget: $0.40 total, $0.3986 spent, ~$0.0014 remaining in probe budget
- 199 probes remain to spend
- All 4 axes have failure boundaries already located

**Most Important Failure:**
The **low_light.illuminance_lux** axis shows the most critical failure mode. The vision pipeline fails catastrophically when illuminance drops below ~12.98 lux, with mAP@50 dropping below 0.367 (60% of the baseline 0.611). This represents severe performance degradation in low-light conditions and is the most impactful failure discovered so far, though it already has excellent coverage at 88.42%.

**Proposed Allocation (Approved):**
I allocated 188 probes across the underexplored axes:
- **motion_blur.exposure_ms**: 75 probes (currently only 17.4% coverage) — most critically under-validated
- **fog.beta_per_m**: 55 probes (30.07% coverage) — second priority
- **jpeg.quality**: 38 probes (23.85% coverage) — third priority  
- **low_light.illuminance_lux**: 20 probes (88.42% coverage) — already well-understood despite being the most important failure

This strategy maximizes information gain by focusing on the axes with the least validation coverage while maintaining minimal sampling on the already well-characterized low-light boundary.
